row.notes: Resizes the physics world's per-worker contexts to the solver job-queue thread count (job queue +0xca8 -> +0x24 when multithread flag +0x130 set, else 1): frees old per-thread pointers (+0x10) and 0x18-byte worker slots (+0xcb0), allocates new ones and builds the vtable-0x145a5ac60 slot array. Callers Ne_PhysWorld_InitFromConfig and Ne_PhysWorld_RunIntegratorJobs (every step).
